sources.snippet: Abstract Maestro1-9B is a dense, 9-billion-parameter vision-language model built for hard problems: multi-step mathematical proof, competitive-programming-grade code synthesis, and visual reasoning over images and video — within a single model and a single context window of up to 1M tokens.

sources.title: vectionlabs/Maestro1-9B • hfviewer
sources.snippet: A Qwen3.5-family multimodal text-generation model from the XORTRON Criminal Computing project, fine-tuned from a DavidAU Qwen3.6 27B Fable Fusion base as an AI-safety and alignment research experiment. An action-conditioned world model for Counter-Strike 2 that takes keyboard and mouse actions and imagines the next frames.
